entries.title: Book VII: The Heart
entries.content:
"El corazón marca el ritmo de la vida."
(The heart sets the rhythm of life.)

entries.title: Book VII: The Heart
entries.content: The heart sits between two worlds. Still a centre of life and vitality, yet increasingly described as a muscular organ—structured, connected, and visible.

entries.title: Book VII: The Heart
entries.content: What was once an abstract source of life becomes something that can be seen, handled, and examined.
